In addition to composi- tional information, PSSM provides important information of evolutionary significance about residue conservation at a given position in a protein sequence. The multiple sequence alignment information in the form of position specific scoring matrix (PSSM) has been used here to develop learning model where each glycosylated protein sequence was first searched against ‘SWISS- PROT’ database followed by generation of alignment profiles or position specific scoring matrices (PSSM) using PSI-BLAST v 2.2.20 program (ftp://ftp.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/blast/executables/ blast+/LATEST/).
